description: This file defines theme tokens and color palette functions for the Ocean Professional theme, including color schemes, typography, and methods for generating categorical color palettes and mapping categories to colors.

methods.name: getOceanTheme
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette for categorical data, seeded by Ocean theme colors, with support for more than predefined seed colors.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap
methods.description: Maps category names to colors using the categorical palette, maintaining stable order.
